technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with golden cross and strong volume spike, but overbought conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 22), and long-term alignment concerns limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 49 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; mixed signals warrant caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (305.44), rising dollar, and negative macro score (-8) creates hostile environment for industrials; earnings in 49 days provides moderate buffer but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with 15x volume spike and supertrend bullish signal provides short-term momentum entry, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (21/100) creating contrarian opportunity near support at 231.32.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals (RSI 67, StochRSI overbought, stoch bearish cross), weak trend strength (ADX 22), inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, zero fundamental support, and price below 200-SMA create hostile macro environment that overwhelms short-term momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: While SMA 9/21 golden cross and 15x volume spike provide short-term momentum at support, overbought technicals (RSI 67, StochRSI overbought) combined with zero fundamental support and crisis macro conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 305, negative macro score -8) create unfavorable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and crisis VIX environment create systemic headwinds that can reverse short-term momentum; earnings in 49 days add event risk with no fundamental catalyst to justify entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ROK with 42 existing Industrials positions (14.7% sector concentration); adding to existing position during sector weakness and macro crisis violates concentration discipline.
